item.title: 'Not reliable': We asked ChatGPT tricky questions on Swedish migration rules
item.description: ChatGPT gave wrong or misleading answers on nearly a third of the Swedish migration queries submitted to it by The Local, according to three leading migration lawyers who assessed its responses.

item.title: Sweden moves forward with proposal to restrict benefits for immigrants
item.description: The Swedish government has put forward a new proposal which would make immigrants ineligible for benefits like parental pay, housing benefit or child benefits until they have lived in the country for five years.

item.title: Sweden's Council on Legislation criticises retroactive citizenship rules
item.description: The Swedish Council on Legislation has criticised the government's plans to apply new stricter citizenship requirements retroactively to all pending applications from June 6th, arguing that waiting times for citizenship are "already far too long".
